articles.summary: -- A platinum-relapsed SCLC patient achieved 16.7 months progression-free survival following Olvi-Vec and platinum rechallenge, exceeding the PFS achieved following platinum-based first-line therapy -- -- This patient also achieved 84.6% reduction in target lesion size, as previously reported by
articles.title: Genelux Announces Publication of a Deep and Durable Response in a Platinum-relapsed Small Cell Lung Cancer Patient Following Systemically Delivered Olvi-Vec-Primed Immunochemotherapy
